data.long_meaning: Goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is often depicted as a golden-skinned woman with multiple arms, holding a lotus and a gold coin. Sharvikaasya is also known as Lakshmi, the goddess of abundance and good fortune. The name Sharvikaasya carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvikaasya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
